Reset the writable knowledge manifest to the packaged corpus

Source: R/knowledge-corpus.R
reset_knowledge_manifest.Rd

Overwrites the writable project copy of the manifest (the one edited from the application, returned by `knowledge_manifest_path(writable = TRUE)`) with the seed bundled in the installed package.

Usage

reset_knowledge_manifest(confirm = TRUE)

Arguments

confirm

Logical. Must be `TRUE` (default) to proceed; the parameter exists so the caller passes an explicit user confirmation before discarding the writable copy.

Value

The path to the refreshed writable manifest (invisibly).

Details

The writable copy is created once and never auto-refreshed, so that edits made from the app survive package updates (spec 009.2 D1). The flip side is that a copy created against an old corpus keeps listing documents the package no longer ships. Call this to pull the current packaged corpus explicitly — typically wired to a "reset to packaged corpus" action in the RAG admin tab.

See also

[knowledge_manifest_path()], [read_knowledge_manifest()].
